notes: Historias de la Biblia para el canal Cerca de ti: Jonás y el gran pez. Low-poly cálido; idea: puedes huir de Dios, pero Dios nunca huye de ti.

scenes.label: Historias de la Biblia
scenes.title: 3 días dentro de un pez
scenes.visual: under the sea: the great fish swims at us; at 'Jonás' it opens its mouth with a warm light inside (hookUnder)

scenes.title: Dios lo envió a Nínive
scenes.visual: coast at dawn: a beam of light on Jonah; at 'Nínive' he turns and points, a golden arrow grows and the far city glows (callWide)

scenes.title: Huyó al lado contrario
scenes.visual: calm sea: the ship's sail fills at 'huyó' and it sails away from Nineveh; a red arrow points the other way (sailSide)

scenes.title: Una tormenta terrible
scenes.visual: the sky turns dark, waves grow, rain; lightning at 'tormenta'; the sailors panic (stormWide)

scenes.title: Láncenme al mar
scenes.visual: on the deck in the storm: hand on his chest at 'culpa', he jumps into the sea at 'lanzaran' with a splash (deckClose)

scenes.title: Un gran pez se lo tragó
scenes.visual: under the sea: Jonah sinks, the great fish rises with its mouth open and closes it at 'pez' (underSide)

scenes.title: Oró en la oscuridad
scenes.visual: inside the fish: Jonah kneels and prays; at 'Dios' a golden beam falls and he raises his arms (bellyPush)

scenes.title: Al tercer día
scenes.visual: the beach at dawn: the fish opens its mouth and Jonah tumbles out onto the sand at 'dejó', then kneels and praises (shoreThree)

scenes.title: Dios nunca huye de ti
scenes.visual: Jonah walks towards Nineveh; at 'nunca' a beam of light falls on him and the city glows (followBack)

scenes.title: Sígueme para más historias
scenes.visual: wide crane over the beach: Jonah praises facing the sunrise, the fish swims away (craneUp)
